text: めしべが　はなつ　とてつもなく　くさい　においは　２キロさきまで　とどき　きを　うしなわせる。

structure.jp: めしべが　はなつ　とてつもなく　くさい　においは
structure.en: the incredibly foul smell its pistil gives off
reaches as far as two kilometers away, and

structure.jp: きを　うしなわせる。

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: The せる ending means making someone do the action. With き it gives きを　うしなわせる = 'makes you lose consciousness'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: めしべが　はなつ　とてつもなく　くさい　におい
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb, placed before a thing, tells you which thing it is. めしべが　はなつ　とてつもなく　くさい　におい = 'the incredibly foul smell that the pistil gives off'.

patterns.name: 〜ます形 (linking)
patterns.explanation: A verb cut short, as it is before ます, joins on to what follows like 'and'; this is the written-style version of the て ending. とどき = 'reaches, and'.
